name: Eagle Watcher Morag

intro.text: Don't speak. Sea eagle, one o'clock. Gone. Right, I've lost it, and it's your fault. Eyes up, we'll settle this the old way.

win: A good eye on you. I'll try again with the binoculars the right way round.
after: A sea eagle is the size of a door with a hooked beak. They harass the otters, take fish off the surface, and ignore anyone who isn't a lamb.
